stories.title: Meta Unveils Camera-Free Smart Glasses, New Avatars, and an AI Training Opt-Out
stories.summary: Meta introduced smart glasses that drop the camera found on earlier models. The company also showed new holographic avatars and said users can opt out of letting their glasses' visual data train its AI. The Verge called the glasses Meta's real next VR device.
stories.whyItMatters: The moves show Meta weighing wearable ambitions against privacy concerns over always-on cameras and AI data use.
